_comment: Alert definitions to create in OpenObserve (Alerts -> Add alert). Replace <STREAM> with the stream that holds the SOLIDserver logs. Each alert is created twice: a firing alert (this query, threshold as listed, shared template 'keep-efficientip-firing') and a cleared alert named '<alert_name> (cleared)' (same query, threshold 'less than 1', using its own cleared template whose fingerprint hard-codes '<alert_name>'). See docs/efficientip-openobserve.md. Ported from the old Graylog catalog.

alerts.sql: SELECT host, message FROM "<STREAM>" WHERE match_all('no free leases') ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
alerts.note: dhcpd logs 'network <name>: no free leases' per network, so this already fires on real exhaustion at the shared-network level. The card shows the most recent matching line.

alerts.sql: SELECT host, message FROM "<STREAM>" WHERE match_all('dhcpd') AND (match_all('exiting') OR match_all('failed') OR match_all('not running')) ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
alerts.note: Starting query ported from the Graylog catalog; tune against real log lines before enabling.

alerts.sql: SELECT host, message FROM "<STREAM>" WHERE (match_all('named') OR match_all('bind')) AND match_all('failed') AND match_all('exiting') ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
alerts.note: Tune against real log lines before enabling.

alerts.sql: SELECT host, message FROM "<STREAM>" WHERE (match_all('named') OR match_all('bind')) AND match_all('zone') AND (match_all('not loaded') OR match_all('has errors') OR match_all('loading failed')) ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
